description: Finds when people in other time zones can meet, when the time is not decided yet: the windows on each day when all participants are within their working hours, accounting for weekends, public holidays and daylight-saving changes, and one suggested start time that fits the most days. Saves that suggested time on those days for 30 days and returns a private perfectclock.cc/s/... link that opens it in Perfect Clock.

participants.description: People or places the meeting must suit, each with their own time zone.

label.description: How the participant or place is called in the conversation, e.g. "Anna" or "Tokyo office".

tz.description: IANA time zone of this participant, e.g. Asia/Tbilisi.

title.description: Meeting title, if the user gave one.

tz.description: Time zone whose calendar days are scanned (usually the organizer's).

name: find_meeting_windows
title: Find meeting windows
